_comment: Per-project configuration for scripts/audit-design.sh. Defaults shown are peptidefox-equivalent. Override per project.

_schema.monoCountCap: int — max font-family declarations matching monoFontPattern per stylesheet (cap 8)
_schema.monoFontPattern: string regex — name of the project mono font used in font-family declarations (e.g. 'Brown Mono', 'IBM Plex Mono')
_schema.monoWhitelist: array of strings — class-name suffixes (regex fragments) that are permitted to use mono font; alternated with | and matched against the selector preceding the rule
_schema.classPrefix: string — project class prefix (e.g. 'dp-', 'pf-'); informational only, not enforced
_schema.stylesheetGlob: string — directory under project root containing component CSS files to audit (e.g. 'app/styles/components')
